context: a single passage from a letter by J. D. Hooker, which you are answering on its own
exchanges: I have begun my Introd: Essay to Tasmania Flora. I think I shall confine it to a clear exposition of all the main features of the Flora of Australia & leave all conclusion drawing to others. I find there are already upwards of 100 Europ. plants well naturalize⁠⟨⁠d⁠⟩⁠ in vicinity of Melbourne already.
I am very sorry to hear that you do not intend to give generalisations in your Tasmanian Introduction, but I do not believe you will be able to resist: what is in the spirit must come out.
